Image 1 is a material/style reference for the living tree: rich carved golden-brown bark, dark creases and restrained moss. transparencyRetry.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied Campfire sprite. Remove the entire white and grey checkerboard so the background is ACTUALLY TRANSPARENT with an alpha channel (alpha 0), not a painted checkerboard, not white, not black. Preserve exactly the fire, charred wood, brown roots, stones, fine leaf and root edges, colours, complete silhouette and original composition. Do not add or redraw objects, do not crop the feet or flame. Output one transparent PNG cutout ready for a 2D game.
